chunks.title: RKA-Lab
chunks.text: RKA-Lab evaluates whether remembered evidence survives recognition, recall, source recollection, and correct action. Its included 10-item deterministic snapshot verifies the software path and is not the planned full benchmark.

chunks.title: TxnMem
chunks.text: TxnMem is a transactional shared-memory service for concurrent agent teams. It gives typed update semantics to shared records and checks replayable histories against a deterministic serial interpreter.

chunks.title: ChronicleGuard
chunks.text: ChronicleGuard is a source-aware platform for evaluating whether language received after a visual event changes later recall. It keeps raw episodic evidence separate from mutable current-world beliefs.

chunks.title: IntentLedger
chunks.text: IntentLedger is a cancellation-safe prospective-memory runtime. It rechecks lifecycle state, trigger evidence, preconditions, version, and idempotency immediately before execution.

chunks.title: FreshIndex
chunks.text: FreshIndex schedules proactive verification when mutable agent memories exceed available audit capacity. It assigns age-aware priorities, explains them, and records decisions in a tamper-evident log.

chunks.title: RecallResolve
chunks.text: RecallResolve targets exact consumer-product recall variant resolution. Its design calls for active acquisition of the least burdensome photo, barcode, label, receipt field, structured answer, or official lookup needed to resolve uncertainty.

chunks.title: HippoGate
chunks.text: HippoGate uses a belief-state decision model to choose whether to forget, retain episodically, probe, or consolidate a candidate memory. Decisions expose their posterior, costs, horizon, recurrence estimate, and probe likelihoods.

chunks.title: HypothesisOps
chunks.text: HypothesisOps is a platform for safe sequential cloud-incident diagnosis. It maintains competing causal explanations and selects bounded observations or sandbox interventions that can distinguish them.

chunks.title: MethodChain
chunks.text: MethodChain reconstructs experimental procedures whose parameters are distributed across cited methods and supporting files. Resolved fields point to exact source spans, while missing evidence remains explicit.

chunks.title: ChangePilot
chunks.text: ChangePilot analyzes Python API usage across dependency-version boundaries, traces affected local calls, stages conservative edits, and rejects changes outside the declared rewrite set.

chunks.title: MemEquiv
chunks.text: MemEquiv is an offline test harness with executable metamorphic contracts for persistent agent memory. It checks facts, uncertainty, scope, provenance, and future behavior under declared relations between histories.

chunks.title: CurriGraph
chunks.text: CurriGraph estimates how practice on one task family affects another, represents those estimates as a directed transfer graph, and uses the graph to select the next experience under a fixed budget.

chunks.title: Communicate to Remember
chunks.text: Communicate to Remember jointly routes communication and memory for multi-agent systems. A contextual-bandit controller chooses whether to drop, send, broadcast, keep, or store information.

chunks.title: ScopeGuard
chunks.text: ScopeGuard attributes memory influence at the tool-argument level, checks that influence against explicit scope and authority, repairs unauthorized changes, and records an audit trace.

chunks.title: WorldModel-L*
chunks.text: WorldModel-L* learns hidden tool behavior before an agent commits to a plan. It combines bounded semantic proposals with an explicit symbolic version space and blocks model-dependent plans while relevant uncertainty remains.

chunks.title: LineageRAG
chunks.text: LineageRAG asks whether agreeing documents are independent or copied. It infers likely derivation links, groups documents into origin families, and combines evidence at the family level.

chunks.title: RobustAsk
chunks.text: RobustAsk treats a clarification answer as an observation from an uncertain channel. It models field values, reliability, systematic confusion, and fatigue before asking, checking, acting, or abstaining.

chunks.title: FALSIFY
chunks.text: FALSIFY searches for minimal counterexamples to selectively stored procedures in tool-using agents. The repository keeps broader claims behind matched-cost evaluation on public environments.

chunks.title: RegimeBank
chunks.text: RegimeBank keeps separate memories for operating regimes that can disappear and return. It detects changes, preserves earlier banks, and reactivates them when a prior regime recurs.

chunks.title: MemIntervene
chunks.text: MemIntervene records memory operations, restores a decision checkpoint, applies a typed intervention, and replays the agent under the same protocol to measure how memory changes later action.

chunks.title: CertiCompress
chunks.text: CertiCompress treats each memory consolidation as an untrusted proposal. A proposal becomes active only after typed semantic checks, provenance checks, and deterministic behavior replay.

chunks.title: TEMPO-Trust
chunks.text: TEMPO-Trust keeps source reliability local to topic, claim type, time, and detected regime. It groups dependent sources, detects drift, and abstains when independent support is too weak.

chunks.title: TempoRGS
chunks.text: TempoRGS studies reader-aware parallel anytime reranker-guided graph search under latency budgets. Its included MiniTempoRGS results are engineering smoke measurements rather than public-benchmark results.

chunks.title: ParamLedger
chunks.text: ParamLedger treats a model adapter as a compiled view of an authoritative experience ledger. Updates promote only after evidence and governance checks and can later be quarantined or replaced through measured rollback.

chunks.title: VerifySplit
chunks.text: VerifySplit studies generator-verifier agreement caused by shared model, trajectory, or evidence errors. The included synthetic smoke results verify the artifact path, not the full research thesis.

chunks.title: EvidRoute
chunks.text: EvidRoute is an offline-first implementation of risk-constrained sequential evidence routing. Given a query, budget, and risk target, it selects a source or terminates with answer, clarification, or abstention.

chunks.title: TraceMem
chunks.text: TraceMem is publicly described as causal reliability mapping for persistent agents using fault injection, counterfactual replay, and pre-commit verification. Detailed claims are omitted because only repository-level metadata is in the approved source set.

chunks.title: BarrierNow
chunks.text: BarrierNow combines versioned evidence, freshness decay, movement constraints, route-level risk bounds, active source selection, and calibrated abstention for accessible route previews. It is not safety certification or emergency navigation.

chunks.title: WhoFixesThis
chunks.text: WhoFixesThis constructs competing provider and service hypotheses, searches dated evidence, checks likely duplicates, and selects a supported civic-service route or abstains. Its demo uses fictional jurisdictions and never submits a report.

chunks.title: Curated project ranking
chunks.text: Rank 1: ChaffMem, project 24. Rank 2: MemEquiv, project 21. Rank 3: SynthesisAutopsy, project 41. Rank 4: RowWitness, project 46. Rank 5: ProbeDiff, project 45. Rank 6: VeriForget, project 35. Only MemEquiv has a verified public repository source; the other ranked entries remain title-only and pending.
